subtitle: J198/02 Section B: Hannibal and the Second Punic War, 218–201 BC

sections.title: Reasons for the outbreak of the Second Punic War

topics.title: Treaty of Lutatius, Iberia and Hannibal's Motives
points: Impact of the First Punic War and Treaty of Lutatius; colonisation of Iberia by Hamilcar and Hasdrubal; Hannibal's personal motivations for war against Rome

sections.title: The nature and dynamics of Hannibal's leadership

topics.title: Saguntum, Alps, Trebia, Trasimene and Cannae
points: Siege of Saguntum, crossing of the Alps; Battles of Trebia, Trasimene and Cannae; failure to march on Rome and Fabian tactics

sections.title: The changing nature of Rome's response to Hannibal

topics.title: Fabius Maximus and Scipio Africanus
points: Leadership of Sempronius, Flaminius, Varro and Paullus; impact of Fabius Maximus as dictator; Scipio Africanus' campaign in Iberia and invasion of Africa

topics.title: Withdrawal from Italy and the Battle of Zama
points: Reasons for Hannibal's withdrawal from Italy; Numidian cavalry supporting Rome; the Battle of Zama and consequences for Carthage and Rome
